name: rmt-tasks-read
description: Read-only access to Ryan Meetup tasks, notes, comments, projects, contacts, calendar data, work metrics, and RY-D sales.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the private Ryan Meetup Tasks workspace through a dedicated read-only API. It cannot create, edit, delete, or upload workspace data.

tools.name: get_workspace_overview
tools.description: Read workspace catalogs, data counts, and integration summary.

tools.name: search_workspace
tools.description: Search tasks, notes, projects, categories, and contacts.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List and filter tasks, including archived work when requested.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Read one task with comments, checklist, activity, and attachment metadata.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Read one note and its comments.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List task and note comments with their author and parent context.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read a project with tasks, owners, grants, and attachments.

tools.name: get_category
tools.description: Read a category with tasks, owners, grants, and attachments.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: Read the contacts directory and its people.

tools.name: get_work_metrics
tools.description: Calculate throughput, aging, workload, and cycle-time evidence.

tools.name: list_governance_activity
tools.description: Read owner-only audit and access-control records.

tools.name: get_ryd_sales_insights
tools.description: Profile RY-D buyers and revenue by name, email type, gifts, and form answers.

tools.name: list_ryd_orders
tools.description: List RY-D orders with verification status and linked form answers.

api_url.title: RMT Tasks API URL
api_url.description: Keep the default unless you are developing against localhost.

read_token.title: Read token
read_token.description: Dedicated RMT MCP read token. This is not a Supabase key.
